english.title: Contravene police direction preventing harassment at home
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who was present outside or, in the vicinity of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), that were used by the resident, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), as

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

dwelling, knowingly contravened a direction given by a constable under Section 42(1) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001, namely **(..SPECIFY DIRECTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(7) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 29 of the Public Order Act 1986 for an interpretation of "dwelling".
(ii) This Section does not include any power to direct a person to refrain from conduct that is lawful under Section 220 of the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992 (right to peacefully picket a work place).
(iii) See Sections 42(1)(b) and (c) for the range of factors on which a constable must be satisfied.

other.powersofarrest: Subsection 42(8) provides a specific power of arrest:- 'A constable in uniform may arrest without warrant any person he reasonably suspects is committing an offence under this section'.
other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.
